tasks.short: Determine fire causes and possible prevention

steps.what: Examine the actual fire scene, physical evidence and available investigation records
Discuss the actual event sequence and uncertainty with witnesses and responsible personnel
Read and capture selected source events with identifiers, timestamps and uncertainty
Assemble selected source events into a linked investigation chronology
Determine supported fire causes and how the actual fire could have been prevented
Write and check the actual working cause and prevention account with evidence limits
Save the working investigation account in the same document store

tasks.design: Render the engineer's selected event records into a linked chronology in {SPREADSHEET} and {DOCS}. Keep scene examination, witness conversations, source coding, cause determination and the actual working findings with the engineer.
tasks.previous_blocker: Selected events were copied into chronological order after source review.
tasks.enabler_now: Fixed event identifiers, timestamps and uncertainty fields can support repeatable assembly without inferring causation.
tasks.still_hard: Clock differences, destroyed evidence and conflicting witness accounts constrain any conclusion.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer weighs physical evidence and alternative explanations.

ambition.what: No expanded investigation or finding-release authority.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: selected event fields can form a linked chronology, while physical fire-cause determination remains expert work.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual investigation and its working account. Any formal finding submission, insurer report or external publication requires its actual final-version authority and separate send; none is hidden in a save.

The engineer produces scene observations and captures event identifier, source locator, timestamp, clock basis and uncertainty in s1-s3. {OTHER} denotes actual scene instruments and event records; missing or incomparable times remain manual.
Test native chronology views before code. Existing automatic event ordering earns zero new gain. No free structured witness account or machine cause finding is assumed.
Save1 is minimum integer representation of near-zero same-system effort, fully retained and ungated. Shares are unmeasured episode estimates.
research_questions: Can each chronology row preserve uncertainty and its original source?

already_counted.description: Scene work, conversations, source capture, cause reasoning and working-account checks remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain event-field mapping and test uncertain timestamp rendering.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R90 gives gross10 less upkeep2, net8. Low: event clocks and witness time estimates are not directly comparable, leaving7 of10 chronology hours manual;3 saved less2 upkeep gives1. Source capture, physical investigation, cause judgment and actual account writing remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read actual site fire-protection references and select suitable teaching examples
Design the site-specific learning objectives, exercise and lesson sequence
Assemble the selected site figures, source links and exercise sections in the training template
Write the fire-protection explanations and exercise prompts for the actual site

loop.purpose: Draft explanations bound to selected site references
loop.input: lesson design and selected source passages
loop.output: draft lesson explanations and exercise prompts
loop.check: engineer checks every safety statement and site instruction against the actual references
loop.stop: one draft and correction pass; unsupported wording is removed or written manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Explanations depend on site context and learners, beyond fixed field copying.

steps.what: Check the complete lesson for site accuracy and suitable fire-protection instruction
Save the training materials in the same store
Conduct the actual fire-protection training and discuss learners' application questions

tasks.design: Assemble selected site examples with a native {DOCS} training template and use a bounded loop for source-bound draft explanations. The engineer checks the complete material and conducts the actual training.
tasks.previous_blocker: First preparation repeated figure assembly and explanatory drafting.
tasks.enabler_now: Templates can reuse exact chosen material; a bounded prose loop can draft from the engineer's references.
tasks.still_hard: Generic advice may conflict with the site's actual arrangements or confuse learners.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer adapts explanations and recognizes unsafe misunderstandings.

ambition.what: Add a site-specific scenario discussion to the existing training offer.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: selected-source assembly and checked draft prose can support preparation of fire-protection teaching material.

assumptions: Episode includes actual initial material development and training delivery; do not charge initial preparation again for each repeated session.
The engineer selects source locators, site figure versions, examples and objectives in s1-s2. No free cleaned site instructions or model-generated safety procedure is assumed.
Test existing native templates first. Already automated assembly earns no new saving.

Any actual online publication, material send or completion certification requires its own real final authority and action. In-person teaching is actual human communication, not a hidden automated send.
Same-system save1 is near-zero, fully retained and ungated; author checking is ordinary content work. Shares are unmeasured activity estimates.
unknowns: Frequency of new versus repeated training
research_questions: How much draft correction remains for the actual site instructions?

already_counted.description: Source choice, lesson design, prose checking, complete-material checks and live teaching remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain source links, template fields and draft examples.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R80.5 gives gross19.5 less upkeep3, net16.5. Low: site figure versions do not fit the template, leaving10 of15 assembly hours, and sensitive instructions retain13.5 of15 prose hours;5+1.5 saved less3 upkeep gives3.5. Live instruction and complete checking remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read source studies and capture actual material, ignition-source and test-condition definitions
Design the actual comparison of ignition sources and materials and choose test conditions
Carry out the actual permitted study tests and record their conditions and observations
Assemble selected test fields into fixed material and ignition comparison tables
Verify the comparison and determine what the evidence shows about how fires start
Write the actual working study findings and comparability limits
Save the working study record in the same store

tasks.design: Render the engineer's selected observations from {OTHER}, the existing fire-test data system, into fixed comparison tables in {SPREADSHEET}. Keep actual test work, comparability judgments and the working findings in {DOCS} with the engineer.
tasks.previous_blocker: Selected test fields were transferred into comparison tables by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: Versioned material, source and test-condition fields can drive repeatable tables.
tasks.still_hard: Different specimen states and test conditions can invalidate comparisons.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer determines whether observed ignition behavior supports an explanation.

ambition.what: Compare an additional defined material condition against the same study design.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: fixed study fields can populate comparison tables without deciding material comparability or fire causation.

assumptions: This is the actual study-and-test branch of the task, not a promise to replace physical testing with generated data.
The engineer captures material identifier, specimen condition, ignition-source identifier, test conditions, units and source locator in s1-s3. Missing or incompatible conditions stay manual.
Test native exports and table configuration first. Existing test runtime and automatic acquisition earn no new labour saving.

s3 denotes work under the existing permitted test setup, not a new or changed hazardous procedure. Any actual altered test authorization or formal external finding release needs its own real authority and action.
Working record writing is separate from test work; the minimum share1 same-system save is fully retained and ungated. Shares are unmeasured estimates.
research_questions: Which observed conditions can be compared without new experimental interpretation?

already_counted.description: Source capture, study design, actual tests, interpretation and working-record writing remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain test-field mapping and unit checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R90 gives gross10 less upkeep2, net8. Low: specimen and test-condition metadata are not comparable, retaining8 of10 table-assembly hours;2 saved covers2 upkeep, net0. Real tests, material judgments and findings remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop prevention plans for fire, wind and water destruction

steps.what: Inspect and review actual site exposures, drawings and existing protective arrangements
Determine prevention measures and capture their site references, priorities and design assumptions
Assemble selected drawing references, measure schedules and fixed plan sections
Write the working plan's rationale and limitations for the selected fire, wind and water measures

loop.input: selected measures, source locators and explicit design assumptions
loop.check: engineer verifies every measure description and risk statement against actual evidence
loop.stop: one draft and correction pass; unsupported statements are written manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Site-specific rationale needs prose beyond a fixed schedule.

steps.what: Check the complete prevention plan against actual exposures, references and drawing versions
Save the working prevention plan in the same store

tasks.design: Assemble the engineer's selected measures and drawing references from {OTHER}, the site drawing system, into a working {DOCS} plan. A bounded loop drafts rationale from those selections; the engineer keeps risk decisions and the complete plan check.
tasks.previous_blocker: Working plans repeated schedule and drawing-reference assembly plus first-draft rationale.
tasks.enabler_now: Versioned fields support deterministic assembly and source-bound draft prose.
tasks.still_hard: Fire, wind and water risks interact with site constraints and incomplete drawings.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer chooses defensible protection measures and recognizes unresolved exposure.

ambition.what: Compare an alternative prevention-measure set against the same mapped site evidence.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: selected measure schedules and drawing references can populate a working plan, with checked prose support for rationale.

assumptions: Boundary includes developing the actual complete working prevention plan. Formal issue for implementation, customer submission or contractual commitment requires its real final-version authority and separate action; none is hidden in the save.

The engineer produces exposure evidence in s1 and captures measure identifier, hazard, site reference, drawing version, priority and rationale in s2. No free clean building model or machine-selected mitigation is assumed.
Test native drawing schedules and document templates before code. Existing automatic assembly earns zero new gain. Incompatible layers and missing references remain manual.
Save1 is minimum integer near-zero same-system effort, fully retained without self-approval. Actual content checks are retained authorship work, not a gate on saving.
Shares are unmeasured episode estimates; source work reused from an actual investigation must be counted once.
unknowns: Existing prevention-plan templates and native schedules
research_questions: Can each assembled measure remain linked to the correct site drawing and explicit assumption?

already_counted.description: Site review, measure decisions, draft prose checking and whole-plan validation remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain drawing-field mappings, template sections and rationale checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R79 gives gross21 less upkeep4, net17. Low: incompatible drawing layers retain10 of15 assembly hours and unusual combined hazards retain13 of15 rationale hours;5+2 saved less4 upkeep gives3. Site review, measure decisions and whole-plan checks remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Investigation, protection choices and teaching remain human; less time goes to chronology, table and document assembly.
reach: Work with the site drawing coordinator on version and layer conventions; learn how references survive drawing revisions.
role.ambitious_version: An engineer who can compare more prevention options using traceable site evidence while retaining responsibility for fire-protection judgment.
